description:
The Rotary Club of Mumbai West Coast organised its Nation Builder Award (NBA) Ceremony to honour and recognise the dedicated contribution of educators who play a vital role in shaping young minds and building the future of our nation.

The ceremony was graced by our esteemed Chief Guest, Dr. Suhas Pednekar, Former Vice-Chancellor, University of Mumbai. We were also privileged to have with us PDG Dr. Balakrishna Inamdar, along with Dr. Jayant Apte, Education Director, Ghanshyamdas Saraf College; Mr. Suhas Naik Satam Accomplished Astronomy and Space Science Educator; Dr. Preeti Oza, Principal, Ghanshyamdas Saraf College of Arts & Commerce; and Mrs. Rupa Shah, Coordinator, Saraf College.

Their presence and support added great significance to the occasion and contributed to making the programme a memorable celebration of educators.
121 Educators were feliciatated
